parameters.name: AccessGroup
parameters.description:
The permission group name.

This parameter is required if the file system is a General-purpose NAS file system.

Default permission group: DEFAULT_VPC_GROUP_NAME (the default permission group for VPCs).
>Not supported for Agentic file systems.

parameters.name: AgenticSpaceId
parameters.description:
The AgenticSpace ID.
>This parameter is required for Agentic file systems.

parameters.name: EnabledRam
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the RAM policy.
Valid values:

- true: enabled.
- false (default): not enabled.

> After you enable the access point RAM policy, all Resource Access Management (RAM) users are denied access to mount and access data through the access point by default. You must grant the corresponding access permissions through authorization and mount the file system through the access point. After you disable the RAM policy, the access point allows anonymous mounting. For more information about how to configure access point permissions, see [Configure an access point policy](~~2545998~~).

>For Agentic file systems, this parameter must be set to true.

parameters.name: OwnerGroupId
parameters.description:
The owner group ID.

This parameter is required if the RootDirectory directory does not exist.
>Not supported for Agentic file systems.

parameters.name: OwnerUserId
parameters.description:
The owner user ID.

This parameter is required if the RootDirectory directory does not exist.
>Not supported for Agentic file systems.

parameters.name: Permission
parameters.description:
The POSIX permission. Default value: "0755". Limit: The value must be a four-digit octal number that starts with 0.

This parameter takes effect after you specify the OwnerUserId and OwnerGroupId parameters.
>Not supported for Agentic file systems.

parameters.name: PosixGroupId
parameters.description:
The POSIX group ID.
>Not supported for Agentic file systems.

parameters.name: PosixSecondaryGroupIds
parameters.description:
The secondary group IDs. Separate multiple group IDs with commas (,).
>Not supported for Agentic file systems.

parameters.name: PosixUserId
parameters.description:
The POSIX user ID.
>Not supported for Agentic file systems.

parameters.name: RootDirectory
parameters.description:
The root directory of the access point.
Default value: "/". If the access point directory does not exist, you must also specify the OwnerUserId and OwnerGroupId parameters.
>Not supported for Agentic file systems.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The list of access point tags.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description:
The tag key.
Limits:

- The tag key cannot be empty or an empty string.
- The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length.
- The tag key cannot start with aliyun or acs:.
- The tag key cannot contain http:// or https://.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description:
The tag value.
Limits:

- The tag value cannot be empty or an empty string.
- The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length.
- The tag value cannot contain http:// or https://.
